games.name: ⛺ MOUNT SUNDA
games.desc:
🏞️ Mount Sunda!

Ready to escape the city and breathe in some fresh mountain air? Welcome to Mount Sunda, a scenic and thrilling hiking game set in the heart of West Java, Indonesia! 🌿

Grab your backpack, wear your safety helmet, and set off on an unforgettable trek through lush rainforests, bamboo groves, and rocky trails leading up the majestic slopes of Gunung Sunda. 🏔️

✨ FEATURES:

🌅 Realistic sunrise & sunset views from the summit

🏕️ Campsites, waterfalls, and secret caves to discover

🧭 Find rare badges and folklore anomalies!

🧗 Challenging obstacles with friends, compete to reach the peak first!

🐻 Capybara's wildlife and interactive nature encounters

Inspired by the real Mount Sunda in West Java, this game brings the spirit of Indonesian hiking culture to life. Whether you're here to relax or race to the top, Mount Sunda is your ultimate Roblox outdoor adventure!

Tag your friends, explore the beauty, and conquer the mountain! 🌄
